transcription.text: They wake in the eerie glow of moonlight
World has gone forever long ago
Lost in the rise, the shine
So bright you're waking in the morning
And where do you get these thoughts?
Inside your mind a voice is calling
For the night to rise at your side
Our world has come forever long ago
Lost in the rays that shine with mystery
Lost we may in the shadows of our time
So hear their voice, sharing their yearning
Hear their voice, sharing their memories
A world that's gone forever, long ago, lost to the light
There, shined with mystery, lost, remained in shadows
All lost time, whispering in the moonlight
So hear their voice, sharing their yearning
Hear their voice, sharing their memories
